Speaker: Draven
Text: The steamwright who wouldn't stay in his workshop. You've caused me considerable inconvenience, Kael.

Speaker: Kael
Text: You caused the Rift. You killed my wife. You trapped my daughter. This ends now.

Speaker: Draven
Text: The Rift was the beginning of a new age! Interdimensional energy — limitless power! And you'd throw it all away for one girl?

Speaker: Kael
Text: She's not 'one girl.' She's my daughter. And these people behind me? They all lost something to your ambition.

Speaker: Draven
Text: Then come. Let's see if a father's love is stronger than the power of three worlds.
